_comment: Default configuration for the forms addon. Override any key in app-custom-config.json.
_comment_form_submit: Submitting a form needs form-submit, asked through ApiContext.requirePermission like every add-on route (#1749), so refusals, step-up and audit come from core. This policy grants it to every built-in role, anonymous included, which keeps forms open as they always were. A deployment narrows it in app-custom-config.json or adds its own roles; who sees a form is the page's audience, and an add-on that receives a form checks its own permission. Code never names a role.

form-submit.description: Submit a form on a page; the page's own access rules can narrow it

ngdpbase.access.policies.name: Submit forms
ngdpbase.access.policies.description: Anyone may submit a form, unless the page it is on says otherwise
